name: Real history
grading_rules: Grade the claim as stated. Documented = a clear statement (ideally a page lead or two cards) of mainstream fact; the fact that scholars argue X is Documented. Debated = the evidence reports disagreement, partial or general influence, uncertain attestation, or rests on one thin/hedged sentence. Legend = popular story or myth the evidence presents as such or contradicts. Interpretation = narrator framing or a history-to-fiction parallel. Unsupported = no card says it.
